notes.title: Stealthfest Demo Now Live
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42818731/153212fb45e89f709622207542e62691f7bb9d10.png[/img]

Hi all-

The Steam Stealthfest has started and an updated demo for Covert Critter is now live! It includes an updated ranking system for each level as well as partial controller support. So go check it out and give it a wishlist! As always, if you have any feedback feel free to post it here, on the discussion board, or with the in-game form.

Thanks,
sodaraptor

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2111370/Covert_Critter/

notes.title: Covert Critter is basically Metal Gear Solid with lizards
notes.notes:
Sneaking out at some point, Covert Critter is an upcoming stealth action game that will have Native Linux support. It's also pretty much Metal Gear Solid with animals.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2022/08/covert-critter-is-basically-metal-gear-solid-with-lizards
